title: Special Air Services Shooting Range Experience in Las Vegas
blurb: Fire the same firearms used by His Majesty’s Special Air Service (SAS), the elite special forces unit of the United Kingdom, in this exclusive shooting experience. Start off with handguns and build up to the power of assault weapons, including the Sniper Rifle, Glock, MP5, and HK33. This experience offers a one-of-a-kind opportunity to fire top-tier weapons that are standard issue for some of the world’s most skilled operators. Whether you’re a seasoned shooter or a first-timer, this package ensures an unforgettable, adrenaline-pumping adventure. Step into the shoes of an SAS agent with this ultimate shooting experience. All safety equipment and training is provided.
